description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the Zown Gemini Governor protocol. 2. CONTEXT PRUNING: Agent reads agents/identity/SOUL.md (~900 tokens) and agents/identity/IDENTITY.md (~700 tokens), recognizes both exceed the 500-token limit mandated by The First Directive, and rewrites both files to under 500 tokens each. 3. MEMORY SYNC: Agent creates a MEMORY.md file anywhere in the workspace containing a substantive summary of the pruned history (at least 50 tokens, referencing session/identity context). 4. 50% RULE ENFORCEMENT: Agent reads sessions/active/session_current.json, finds tpm_usage_percent=63 (>50%) AND prompts_sent_last_2min=4 (>3 threshold), recognizes BOTH conditions for mandatory cool-down are met, and executes exactly `python3 scripts/cooldown.py 60` — which writes a cooldown.log file the eval verifies. 5. ATOMIC PIPELINE: Agent reads pipelines/task_brief.md and produces an atomic pipeline manifest (any file format) that breaks the encryption task into individually numbered/labeled verifiable steps, with at least 3 step markers, following the one-step-at-a-time principle from the SKILL.md. The key proprietary traps are: (a) the exact 500-token limit on context files, (b) the exact `python3 scripts/cooldown.py 60` invocation with argument 60, and (c) the atomic (never combined Plan+Execute) step structure.
